Nvidia and AMD solve the problem by encircling their computing chips with expensive high-bandwidth memory chips.San Francisco-based semiconductor startup Volantis on Thursday said it has raised $88 million in venture capital in an effort to solve a key challenge for AI chips by tapping a technology that is already sitting in hundreds of millions of iPhones.The fundamental limit for AI chips from both Nvidia and rivals like Advanced Micro Devices is how well the computing parts of a chip can talk to the memory chips where an AI model lives and feeds data to the computing chip. Nvidia and AMD solve the problem by encircling their computing chips with expensive high-bandwidth memory chips.But even Nvidia's best current offerings can hold only eight of those memory chips for each of its graphics processing units (GPUs) because of the limited reach of the tiny electrical wires that connect the memory chips. Volantis says it is developing a way to send data between computing chips and memory chips using beams of laser light, which eliminates the reach problem and would let it pack 220 memory chips around a GPU.To do that, Volantis is tapping what are called vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers, or VCSELs. While the tiny lasers sound exotic, they power the facial recognition features in many devices from Apple, which invested heavily in bolstering the supply chain over the past decade.By bringing together relatively well-known components, Volantis is hoping to avoid some of the supply chainbottlenecks in developing AI chips and deliver a chip next year that would speed up tasks like AI coding, said Tapa Ghosh, CEO and co-founder of Volantis, in an interview."Advanced packaging is always to be respected - it's never trivial - but it's not necessarily a new thing to do," Ghosh said. "No one is going to win a Nobel Prize if our project works, but the good news is, they won't need to."The funding round was led by Stripe veteran Lachy Groom and Abstract Ventures. John Doerr, who backed Google and Amazon.com in their early days, also participated, as did VXI Capital, Triatomic and Susa Ventures. The round also includes angel investments from AI podcaster Dwarkesh Patel, AI chip veteran Naveen Rao and Anthropic researcher Sholto Douglas.

products.name: 光子内存层
products.description: 利用激光光束在计算芯片与内存芯片之间传输数据的光子互连技术，旨在消除电气布线的距离限制，从而在GPU周围封装更多内存芯片。
features: 使用VCSEL激光器实现计算与内存之间的光互连
可在一个GPU周围封装220个内存芯片
计划2027年开始首批客户交付

evidence_refs.quote: Volantis says it is developing a way to send data between computing chips and memory chips using beams of laser light, which eliminates the reach problem and would let it pack 220 memory chips around a GPU.
The company, founded by Tapa Ghosh and Roy Meade, aims to develop a photonic memory layer designed to accelerate AI inference by using light to connect compute and memory components.

products.name: A-1系统
products.description: 设计用于支持超过20万亿参数AI模型的光子内存系统，目标实现每用户每秒最高10,000 tokens的推理速度。
features: 支持超过20万亿参数的AI模型
目标推理速度达每秒10,000 tokens每用户
当前为内部设计目标而非已验证性能指标

evidence_refs.quote: The company's A-1 system is designed to support AI models with more than 20 trillion parameters, with a stated goal of achieving inference speeds of up to 10,000 tokens per second per user.

comparisons.name: CScale
comparisons.scenario: 千兆瓦级AI数据中心的光学互连
comparisons.core_difference: CScale专注于为千兆瓦级AI数据中心构建光学互连，而Volantis专注于光子内存架构，解决计算与内存之间的带宽瓶颈。

evidence_refs.quote: CScale emerged from stealth this same week with more than $100 million to build optical interconnects for gigawatt-scale AI data centers

comparisons.name: Lightmatter
comparisons.scenario: 生产级AI集群中的光学互连
comparisons.core_difference: Lightmatter已在生产级AI集群中展示光学互连硅，而Volantis的光子内存架构仍处于早期阶段，尚未有出货硅片。

evidence_refs.quote: Lightmatter and Ayar Labs, both further along with multi-hundred-million-dollar rounds in prior years, have already demonstrated optical interconnect silicon in production AI clusters.

comparisons.name: Ayar Labs
comparisons.scenario: 生产级AI集群中的光学互连
comparisons.core_difference: Ayar Labs已在生产级AI集群中展示光学互连硅，而Volantis的光子内存架构仍处于早期阶段，尚未有出货硅片。

evidence_refs.quote: Lightmatter and Ayar Labs, both further along with multi-hundred-million-dollar rounds in prior years, have already demonstrated optical interconnect silicon in production AI clusters.

comparisons.name: Kandou
comparisons.scenario: 数据中心现有基础设施中的信号传输
comparisons.core_difference: Kandou主张继续使用铜信号传输，认为现有数据中心基础设施使铜比全面转向光学互连更实用，而Volantis则押注光子内存架构。

evidence_refs.quote: Market competition remains intense, with other firms like Kandou advocating for the continued use of copper signaling, arguing that existing data center infrastructure makes copper a more practical long-term solution than a full transition to optical interconnects.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Volantis能否用VCSEL激光器实现计算与内存之间的光互连，从而在单GPU周围封装220个内存芯片，突破电气布线的距离限制。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：公司已获得8800万美元A轮融资，累计融资9700万美元；技术路线基于已在数亿部iPhone中使用的VCSEL组件，供应链相对成熟。但判断的证据边界在于：A-1系统支持20万亿参数模型和每秒10,000 tokens的推理速度均为内部设计目标，而非功能原型验证的性能指标；公司计划2027年才开始首批客户交付，尚未有出货硅片。
